sourceMission: NASA DONKI (solar weather) + AES ECLSS baselines + KRUSTY + OSDR RadLab

dataSources.solarFlares: Reference: X8.7 flare 2024-05-14 (Solar Cycle 25 peak, NOAA AR 13664, GOES-18). Largest flare of Solar Cycle 25; observed by GOES-18. NOAA Active Region 13664.
dataSources.cmeAnalysis: NASA DONKI CMEAnalysis API — 259 CME events (2024-11-01 to 2024-12-31). Top speed: 3161 km/s
dataSources.eclss: NASA AES Human Metabolic Baseline JSC-20584
dataSources.kilopower: KRUSTY Demonstration (2018), NASA Glenn Research Center — Poston et al.
dataSources.radlab: NASA OSDR RadLab ISS Dosimetry Database + GCR lunar surface models (Zeitlin 2013, Reitz 2009)
